goal: Learn how to program AI agents using the Vercel AI SDK, including core concepts, supported agent patterns, and practical implementation steps with examples.
tasks: Identify the key features and abstractions in the Vercel AI SDK relevant to AI agents (e.g., Agents, streaming, tools/function calling, state/memory patterns).
Review official Vercel AI SDK documentation, guides, and reference examples to map a learning path from basic usage to full agent workflows.
Find practical tutorials or example repos showing complete agent implementations (tool use, multi-step reasoning/action, system prompts, and integration with external APIs).
Determine recommended development setup and best practices for building and testing agent apps with the Vercel AI SDK (environment variables, logging/telemetry, error handling, evals).
Compile a step-by-step learning plan and project ideas that progressively build agent capabilities using the Vercel AI SDK, with checkpoints and measurable outcomes.
